_README: Vehicle type specifications for the GreenSM fleet simulation.
PROVENANCE. Published manufacturer figures. NOT measured, NOT from GreenSM
telemetry -- no real GreenSM logs exist. Every field carries its source and
the cycle the range is measured on, because NEDC and WLTP differ by ~20% and
quoting one as the other is the single easiest way to be wrong here.
usable_km is what the simulator actually uses, derived as
range_km * realised_range_factor. It is NOT a measured range.
swap_based: true means the vehicle changes battery rather than charging, so
its downtime is a swap duration (seconds) not a charge session (tens of
minutes). That difference dominates fleet dispatch economics and is the
reason a single-type fleet cannot represent a mixed one.

KNOWN UNCHECKABLE. No check can detect a range_km edited upward on its own: a longer claimed range with the same battery and the same realised factor simply lowers kWh/km, and the new value stays inside the plausible band. Only cross-checking the range against an independent source can catch that, which is what scripts/verify_fleet_spec.py's source field is for -- it records where the number came from so a reader can go and check it. Nine of ten injected defects are caught automatically; the tenth is a number this project cannot validate without trusting a source.

e46 REMOVED. An earlier version of this file listed a 'VinFast VF e46 / Nerio Green Plus' at 54.0 kWh / 311 km from model knowledge, not from a source. Web search finds no such model: Nerio Green is the RENAMED VF e34 -- same 44.5 kWh, 285 km NEDC, 110 kW -- commercially renamed from 2025 for fleet economics. The e34 entry already carries the Nerio Green name. No other source for an e46 name was found; one agent asserted from memory that 'e35/e36 renamed VF8/VF9 at CES 2022; no e46 ever', which corroborates. A type fabricated from knowledge is not a type.

MEASURED CROSS-CHECK. docs/literature/vinfast_realworld_vietnam.md records independently measured consumption: VF8 20-22 kWh/100km city, 30 hot-climate; VF9 30-32 city, 20-22 open road; VF e34 ~16.7. The spec's DERIVED figures (battery/usable_km) sit at 15.6-19.5 for e34-class and ~18.6 for the VF8, i.e. at or below the measured band's low end. That is EXPECTED: usable_km already applies the 0.80 realised factor, so the model's per-km cost already embeds the duty-cycle penalty. A derived figure ABOVE the measured band would mean the factor is too harsh; a derived figure far BELOW it would mean the factor is too generous. Only a measured figure can say which.

VF5 DC RESOLUTION. Third-party pages quote 30 kW DC for the VF5; letsgoelectric quotes 50 kW with a 10-80% time of ~30 min. The 30 kW figure fails the official charge-time arithmetic: 0.6 x 37.23 kWh = 22.3 kWh inside the official <33 min 10-70% window (vinfastauto.ph/en/vf5) requires >= 40 kW average, so the peak must exceed 40. 50 kW is therefore adopted, and the 30 kW figure is read as a sustained or derated rate, not the peak. dc_kw is provenance anyway: the sim charges at the 60 kW depot rate (CHARGE_POWER_KW in gsm_sim.py), so this field does not move any published figure.

VF-STD-30. VinFast motorbike ranges are measured under VinFast in-house standard conditions -- constant 30 km/h, 1 rider 65 kg -- NOT NEDC/WLTP/WMTC. Verified verbatim Oct 2026: Evo200 spec row 'vận tốc 30km/h (1 người 65kg): 203km'; Evo/Feliz II/Viper footnotes 'theo điều kiện kiểm thử của VinFast tại 30 km/h'; Feliz S official overview page 'tốc độ trung bình 30 km/h: 198', 3.5 kWh LFP. No official page claims NEDC/WLTP/WMTC for any bike; do not label as such.

MINIO UPGRADE (Jul 2025, shipping Dec 2025). VinFast upgraded Minio Green free: nominal 18.5 kWh (usable 18.3 per VnExpress spec sheet), 210 km NEDC, 100V->400V, DC 24 kW official, 10-70% in 34 min. Pre-upgrade 15.2/170/12 kW figures are stale for 2026 stock.

ECVAN RESOLUTION. Official brochure spec table (Oct 2026 verification): 150 km NEDC, 17 kWh usable, DC 19.4 kW, 42 min 10-70% — verbatim from the PDF. Two independent sources agree on 17 (electrive launch report, EC Van wiki '17 kWh usable'). The 18.3/175 figures trace to one Indian press page (cartoq) possibly quoting gross -- no source states gross explicitly. Adopted 17.0/150/NEDC; the 175 press figure is recorded in the note, not the value.

VF6 RANGE. Spec said 480 NEDC; VinFast Indonesia official lists Eco 470 / Plus 430 NEDC, India lists 468/463 (cycle unstated). Adopted 470 NEDC (Eco, the larger). VF3 AC: brochure 5h for 10-70% of 18.64 kWh implies ~2.2 kW avg; evpick lists 3 kW -- adopted 3.0, the old 7.4 was wrong. VF9 evdb source 404s; GCC kept as sole source.
